description: Creates a new Change Event Production Quantity for a given Change Event.

parameters.name: change_event_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the Change Event

id.description: Unique identifier for this Change Event Production Quantity. Use as the {id} path parameter to update or delete it via /rest/v1.0/projects/{project_id}/change_events/{change_event_id}/change_event_...

cost_code_id.description: ID of the Cost Code this production quantity is attributed to. Kept in sync with wbs_code_id.

quantity.description: Quantity of work for this production item, in the given unit of measure. Returned as a decimal string.

uom.description: Unit of measure for the quantity. Must be a unit from the company's Units of Measure master list that is not categorized as "Time".

description.description: Free-text description of the production quantity item.

wbs_code_id.description: ID of the WBS (Budget) Code this production quantity is attributed to. Kept in sync with cost_code_id.

cost_code_id.description: ID of the Cost Code to attribute this production quantity to. Provide either cost_code_id or wbs_code_id; the other is derived and kept in sync.

quantity.description: Quantity of work for this production item, in the given unit of measure.

uom.description: Unit of measure for the quantity. Must be a unit from the company's Units of Measure master list that is not categorized as "Time".

description.description: Free-text description of the production quantity item.

wbs_code_id.description: ID of the WBS (Budget) Code to attribute this production quantity to. Provide either wbs_code_id or cost_code_id; the other is derived and kept in sync.
